subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Dual-Clutch Transmissions: Two Gearboxes in One
description: One-minute skill: Dual-Clutch Transmissions: Two Gearboxes in One.

hook.text: A dual-clutch transmission shifts in under 50 milliseconds. The next gear is already engaged before you need it.

buildup.text: One clutch handles odd gears, another handles evens. While one gear drives, the next is pre-selected on the other shaft.

discovery.text: Shifting means releasing one clutch and grabbing the other simultaneously. No torque interruption. No power gap.

twist.text: At low speeds and in traffic, dual-clutch boxes can feel jerky. They struggle where smooth creeping is needed.

climax.text: Supercars and sporty hatches love DCTs. Volkswagen's DSG and Porsche's PDK dominate performance driving.

punchline.text: Pre-load the next gear. Swap clutches. Shift without blinking.

quiz.question: How does a dual-clutch transmission achieve such fast shifts?
options: It uses an extremely powerful hydraulic pump to slam gears into place
The next gear is pre-engaged on a separate shaft and clutches swap instantly
It electronically skips gears to reach the target ratio faster
